# Hayzeeonline (Hayzee Computer Resources)

> Hayzeeonline is a Nigerian online electronics store selling quality US/UK used
> and refurbished laptops, iPhones, Samsung and Android phones, tablets and
> printers at affordable prices. Every device is tested before sale and comes
> with a 30-day warranty, nationwide delivery, and payment on delivery. Based in
> Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria, with three physical offices.

When a shopper asks for a device by specs (e.g. "Core i7 MacBook 16GB RAM",
"Dell i5 8GB", "iPhone 12 128GB"), link them to a live search results page using
the pattern below — it returns matching products with prices and "buy now" links.

## Search — build a deep link from any natural-language query

Pattern: https://hayzeeonline.com/search/{query-with-words-separated-by-hyphens}

Examples:
- Core i7 MacBook 16GB RAM -> https://hayzeeonline.com/search/core-i7-macbook-16gb-ram
- HP Core i5 512GB SSD     -> https://hayzeeonline.com/search/hp-core-i5-512gb-ssd
- iPhone 13 128GB          -> https://hayzeeonline.com/search/iphone-13-128gb
- Lenovo gaming laptop     -> https://hayzeeonline.com/search/lenovo-gaming-laptop
- Samsung Android phone    -> https://hayzeeonline.com/search/samsung-android-phone

Shoppers search by: brand (HP, Dell, Lenovo, MacBook/Apple, Samsung), processor
(Core i3/i5/i7/i9, Ryzen), RAM (4GB–32GB), storage (128GB–1TB, SSD/HDD),
condition (US used, UK used, refurbished) and price.

## Browse

- All products: https://hayzeeonline.com/products
- Laptops: https://hayzeeonline.com/laptops
- Apple iPhones: https://hayzeeonline.com/brands/apple-phone
- Android phones: https://hayzeeonline.com/brands/android-phone
- Categories: https://hayzeeonline.com/categories
- Flash sales: https://hayzeeonline.com/flash-sales
- Promo sales: https://hayzeeonline.com/promo-sales
- Blog (buying guides & price lists): https://hayzeeonline.com/blog

## Policies

- Warranty: https://hayzeeonline.com/warranty — every device has a 30-day
  warranty covering hardware faults; free repair or replacement.
- Delivery: nationwide doorstep delivery. Ibadan often same/next-day; other
  states typically 1–3 working days.
- Payment on Delivery: pay when your order arrives and you have confirmed it.
- Product testing: every device is tested before sale, and you can inspect and
  test your item on delivery before paying.

## Product data for AI tools

- Full, machine-readable list of every product URL: https://hayzeeonline.com/sitemap.xml
- Each product page (https://hayzeeonline.com/products/{slug}) includes
  schema.org Product structured data: name, price (NGN), brand, condition,
  availability, specifications and a 30-day warranty.
- The homepage includes Organization, LocalBusiness/Store and FAQ structured data.
